export_evidence: ImportKey India customs record (importkey.com/countries/india/athenese-dx-private-limited), row dated 2026-02-25: "ATHENESE-DX PRIVATE LIMITED | ANNAPURNA SALES | Biochemistry Analyzer (Semi-Auto)- JOGBANI INJBNB, India | Biratnagar, NEPAL | 90278990 | BOL 1005680" — i.e. an outbound shipment from India to Nepal with a bill-of-lading number. Same page lists other export counterparties: USHA PHARMACEUTICALS NIGERIA LTD (45 shipments), IMEX GROUP S.A.S. (40), AARADHYA SCIENTIFIC HOUSE PVT LTD (40), CENTRAL SCIENTIFIC HOUSE (500). Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 1941 Records detected", "Trading Partners 31", "Ports 35", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 shipment rows (4 of them imports into India from China/Hong Kong, 1 export to Nepal). So the 1941 figure is a mixed import+export counter and cannot be read as export volume.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record was retrievable in this session (web_search backend returned connection refused on all queries; volza.com returned HTTP 403). Only company-side claim found: athenesedx.com homepage — "Made in Chennai. Trusted by labs across India." and "171 products in store" with INR retail pricing (e.g. "Typhoid IgG/IgM Rapid Test ₹1,230") — this is a product catalogue/webshop, which per Rule 5 does not count as shipment fact. No dated domestic supply record (invoice, tender, PO) seen.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data; not a rejection case. Export side is factually supported: at least one dated outbound B-L (2026-02-25, India→Biratnagar, Nepal, HS 90278990, BOL 1005680) plus named repeat foreign buyers (Nepal, Nigeria, Colombia/Ecuador via IMEX GROUP S.A.S.), so export_status = confirmed. Note the declared HS 300215 (immunological products, put up in measured doses) does not match the observed export line HS 90278990 (instruments/appliances for physical analysis) nor the observed import lines 38221990 (diagnostic reagents) and 84139190 (pump parts) — per Rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the factual code for the observed export is 90278990 and the record should be kept with HS corrected. Domestic side: the company is a Chennai-based IVD manufacturer with an ISO 13485 claim and an active INR-priced webshop, but no GST turnover band, tender or contract evidence was publicly retrievable here, so domestic_status = declared_only, not confirmed. Revenue and export value: null — ImportKey free view shows shipment counts only, no values; no public financials found. Tool budget exhausted (6 calls); web_search was unavailable throughout, so absence of domestic records is a retrieval limitation, not proof of no domestic supply.
